reason: A client-side entertainment utility that shows a game overlay while the model is generating, with built-in mini-games, bookmarks, and an extensible game registry.

summaries.zh: 模型生成期间显示小游戏菜单和弹窗，提供 Wordle、消消乐及多款参数化小游戏，并支持自定义书签与第三方游戏注册。
summaries.en: Shows a mini-game overlay while the model generates, offering Wordle, match-three, many parameterized games, custom bookmarks, and third-party game registration.

capabilities: Displays a client-side overlay and expandable game menu during model generation
Reads the current session running state to trigger and dismiss the overlay
Provides built-in browser games and custom web bookmark entries
Exposes a client-side game registry for other plugins to add games
